extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic performance figures digitised: Figure 1a–f and Figure 2a–c. Figure 8e/f and Figure 6c/d contain correlations using the same CZA-xZr performance values already plotted in Figure 2a; they were not duplicated as separate reaction-condition records. Figure 7d is a correlation of CO2 conversion with chemisorption uptake, not a separate catalytic test series. Values read from plots are approximate and marked '~'. For Figure 1a-c some low-overlap markers/series were difficult to read; only confidently assigned CZA series points were included. Methane was stated to be below the 5 ppmv GC detection limit but no plotted CH4 selectivity was present.
